 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz 'PBB Collab 3.0' housemates aim for 3M views in vertical drama task 
 By GMA News Published November 7, 2026 12:33pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: PBB The housemates of “Pinoy Big Brother Collab Edition 3.0” are taking on a new challenge as part of their second weekly task, which involves reaching three million views for their vertical drama.
 The task runs from November 7 at 7:15 p.m. until November 8 at noon.
 The vertical drama will be available for viewing on the official social media accounts of “Pinoy Big Brother.”
 " PBB: Collab 3.0 " premiered on October 24. Sixteen housemates , composed of celebrity personalities, social media stars, and ordinary netizens, entered the new PBB house.
